title: Everyone's Darling Has a Secret Reveals Teaser Trailer
content: The previously announced Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret anime has revealed a teaser trailer. Studio Gekko is animating the series and is set to premiere in April 2027. author: Anime Corner

title: Sonic Racing CrossWorlds Game Reveals Year 2 Roadmap; Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond Short Film Reveals Debut Date
content: Sega revealed on Friday a roadmap for Year Two of its Sonic Racing CrossWorlds game. Year Two will launch on November 3 and the company streamed a video showcasing the new updates.
author: ANN

title: Tekken 8 Game Reveals Roger Jr.'s November 11 Early Access Release in Gameplay Trailer
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment started streaming the gameplay reveal trailer for Roger Jr., one of the characters for the Tekken 8 fighting game's Season 3 , on Sunday. The character will be available for early access on November 11, and will launch officially on November 16.
author: ANN

title: 5th Girls und Panzer das Finale Film Streams 10-Minute Opening Video
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks started streaming on Saturday the first 10 minutes of the fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer das Finale film series. title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls Game Reveals Full Roster for Year 1 DLC
content: The staff for PlayStation Studios , Arc System Works , and Marvel Games' Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls 4v4 tag team fighter game revealed in a new video on Sunday Thor (Jane Foster) as the second DLC character included in the "Year 1 Character & Stage Pass" in winter 2027.
author: ANN

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game Streams Trailer for Tekken 8 DLC Character Reina Joining Game in December
content: SNK began streaming on Saturday a DLC character trailer for Reina from the TEKKEN 8 fighting game that will join its Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game in December. SNK also released on Thursday DLC character trailers for Manjiro "Mikey" Sano and Ken "Draken" Ryuguji from the Tokyo Revengers anime.
author: ANN

title: Inori's Homunculus Tears Yuri Novel Gets Manga by Ayster, Dokico
content: German publisher Dokico announced on Saturday that Ayster will draw a manga adaptation of author Inori 's Homunculus Tears: Alchemy for the Brokenhearted ( Homunculus no Namida ~Kietai Kimi e no Renkinjutsu~ ) novel. Dokico will begin releasing the manga in German, English, and Japanese simultaneously in January 2027.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Renai Rubi no Tadashii Furikata Season 2 Reveals More Cast, October 29 Debut
content: The official website for the second season of the live-action series of Ogeretsu Tanaka 's Renai Rubi no Tadashii Furikata (The Right Way to Write Love) boys-love manga revealed more cast members, the October 29 debut on Tokyo MX1, and a new visual for the second season on October 7.
author: ANN

title: 'Kino no Tabi' Creator Duo Begins New Light Novel
content: Publishing company Kadokawa announced on Friday that author Keiichi Sigsawa and illustrator Kouhaku Kuroboshi , the duo behind the Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World ( Kino's Journey: The Beautiful World ) light novel, will launch a new light novel titled Drifted: John Smith no Edo Hyouryuu Kitan .
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure Film's New Video Reveals Bi Clan's Cast
content: TOHO animation began streaming a character trailer for The Apothecary Diaries : The Late Lady's Treasure ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Bо̄hi no Hihо̄ ), the upcoming anime film based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series, on Monday.
author: ANN
